title: Sambal (Safety and justice for women):
summary: Schemes — Sambal (Safety and justice for women):

items: o One Stop Center: Comprehensive support for women in distress.
o 181 Women Helpline: 24/7 support for women in crisis.
o Beti Bachao Beti Padhao: Promote gender equality and the welfare of girls.
o Nari Adalat: Community-based dispute resolution for women.
Key Focus: Empowerment, safety, healthcare, education, and financial support for women,
